title: Bug verification accepts a pass recorded before the failure
symptom: verification() reports reproduced-and-later-passed when any present linked observation passed
trigger: A bug linked to a passing observation older than its failing reproduction
expected: Only a pass observed after the reproduction counts as later-passed
steps: Link an older passed observation and a newer failed one to a bug
impact: A bug can read as verified on stale evidence

notes.text: scope: out-of-scope -> in-scope. Moved in scope for draft change keep-evidence-current-across-commits-and-specsync-lifecycle-bookkeeping-and-verify-bugs-only-by-a-pass-observed-after (grouping agreed by the human; scope approval still pending).
Reproduced before the fix by the new tests; see .chough/artifacts/bug-0014-reproduction.log.
status: open -> verified. Fixed in 4bf46da; the reproduction tests pass at e806f78 (.chough/artifacts/bug-0014-fixed-reproduction.log).
